releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.2.3 (Build 61):
• Path Memory Navigation: Sequential back navigation across all interfaces so pressing back retraces your exact steps
• Unified Hardware & Gesture Back: Closes active overlays/sheets first, then traverses path history step-by-step to root exit guard
• Universal In-App Back Polish: All screen header back buttons and chevrons now seamlessly follow path memory
